summary: Verified CSS regression fix on public homepage header/hero at both desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). All 5 review-request criteria pass: logo constrained to 38x38, brand name + Hindi tagline visible, all desktop nav items shown (Projects, Properties, Gallery, Our story, Contact, +phone, Book a visit), mobile hamburger visible, no horizontal overflow at 390px, hero h1 sits well below header bottom (desktop y=266 vs header bottom 88; mobile y=380 vs header bottom 88), hero-next advances slide from 'Make room for what matters.' to 'Land, patiently curated.', enquire-ribbon opens modal with name/phone/email/message and submit produces success state.

issues: Hero-prev left arrow visually overlaps the kicker text 'PLACES THAT FEEL LIKE YOURS' (the 'P' is covered by the chevron circle). Not part of this fix scope but worth polishing — consider hiding hero-prev/next on <=480px or nudging kicker/arrows to avoid overlap.

critical_code_review_comments: CSS fix in App.css lines 91-97 is minimal and correct — width/height 38px + flex-shrink:0 on brand img prevents the header blowout. .brand-tagline uses white-space:nowrap which is fine because the tagline is short.
Minor polish: on very narrow viewports the hero prev/next chevrons overlap the kicker text; consider media query to hide arrows below 480px.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header/brand CSS regression is fixed and verified at 1920x800 and 390x844. Only cosmetic follow-up noted: hero carousel arrows overlap kicker on mobile — outside the current fix scope.
